 logRead[r_Association] := (AppendTo[readbackLog,
   <|"readback" -> reads, "seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started,
     "A" -> Lookup[r, "A", Null], "finite_real" -> Lookup[r, "finite_real", False],
     "numerically_feasible" -> Lookup[r, "numerically_feasible", False],
     "max_flow_residual" -> Lookup[r, "max_flow_residual", Null],
     "max_null_residual" -> Lookup[r, "max_null_residual", Null],
     "max_factor_residual" -> Lookup[r, "max_factor_residual", Null],
     "min_original_coefficient" -> Lookup[r, "min_original_coefficient", Null],
     "full_min_eigenvalue" -> If[realVectorQ[Lookup[r, "full_eigenvalues", Null]],
        Min[r["full_eigenvalues"]], Null]|>]; r);
 TimeConstrained[
  phaseResult = Catch[TimeConstrained[
   ee = ConstantArray[1, 6];
   path = {1, 2, 3, 6, 5, 4};
   tree = Partition[path, 2, 1];
   cuts = Table[Take[path, k], {k, 5}];
   pairs = Select[Tuples[Range[6], 2], #[[1]] != #[[2]] &];
   off = Select[pairs, ! MemberQ[Sort /@ tree, Sort[#]] &];
   h = Table[Unique["step"], {5}];
   nv = Table[Unique["offtree"], {20}];
   nm = ConstantArray[0, {6, 6}];
   Do[nm[[off[[k, 1]], off[[k, 2]]]] = nv[[k]], {k, 20}];
   cm = Table[If[j <= i, Unique["factor"], 0], {i, 5}, {j, 5}];
   cv = Flatten[Table[cm[[i, j]], {i, 5}, {j, i}]];
   vv = Join[h, nv, cv];
   jj = Join[IdentityMatrix[5], {-ConstantArray[1, 5]}];
   qq = N[Table[Which[i <= j, 1/Sqrt[j (j + 1)],
           i == j + 1, -j/Sqrt[j (j + 1)], True, 0], {i, 6}, {j, 5}]];
   tt = Table[Which[i == j, 1, j < i, h[[j]], True, 0], {i, 6}, {j, 6}];
   zz = tt.ee; om = Join[-2 h, {2 Total[h]}]; la = nm;
   Do[
    {uedge, vedge} = tree[[k]]; cut = cuts[[k]];
    outside = Complement[Range[6], cut];
    aa = Total[om[[cut]]] - Total[Flatten[Table[nm[[i, j]] - nm[[j, i]],
                                                {i, cut}, {j, outside}]]];
    bt = -Total[Flatten[Table[nm[[i, j]] zz[[j]] - nm[[j, i]] zz[[i]],
                                                {i, cut}, {j, outside}]]];
    den = zz[[uedge]] - zz[[vedge]];
    la[[uedge, vedge]] = (zz[[uedge]] aa - bt)/den;
    la[[vedge, uedge]] = (zz[[vedge]] aa - bt)/den,
    {k, 5}];
   lf = DiagonalMatrix[la.ee] - la;
   dd = DiagonalMatrix[Join[h (2 - h), {-Total[h] (Total[h] + 2)}]];
   lt = lf.tt;
   mone = dd + (lt + Transpose[lt])/2;
   mm = Table[If[i <= j, mone[[i, j]], mone[[j, i]]], {i, 6}, {j, 6}];
   bb = mm[[1 ;; 5, 1 ;; 5]]; ff = jj.cm;
   eq = Flatten[Table[(bb - cm.Transpose[cm])[[i, j]], {i, 5}, {j, i}]];
   cons = DeleteCases[Join[
     Thread[eq == 0], Thread[h >= 1/4], Thread[h <= 6],
     Thread[Extract[la, pairs] >= 0], Thread[Extract[la, pairs] <= 400],
     Thread[cv >= -100], Thread[cv <= 100], Thread[Diagonal[cm] >= 0],
     Thread[Flatten[ff] >= -100], Thread[Flatten[ff] <= 100]], True];
   modelBuildElapsed = AbsoluteTime[] - started;

   read[values_List, initialFactor_: False] := Module[
    {rr, vUsed = values, hv, lm, cf, tm, fl, omega, dm, mat,
     prod, single, oldform, discrepancy, mirrorError, originalNull,
     symmetry, oldSymmetry, basisFactor, flow, null, fr, mr, pe, ce, ev,
     oldev, eqr, lv, box, diagok, finite, fdiag, feas, preChecks,
     me, fe, ne, mre, oldne, assemblyError, upper, snapshot, out,
     spectraOK, factorOK, factorError = Null},
    If[reads >= 600, status = "readback_cap"; Throw[$Failed, tag]];
    reads++;
    If[! realVectorQ[values] || Length[values] != 40,
      Return[logRead[<|"finite_real" -> False, "numerically_feasible" -> False,
        "error" -> "invalid_40_vector", "variables_input" -> jsonSafe[values]|>]]];
    rr = Thread[vv -> values]; hv = h /. rr; lm = N[la /. rr];
    If[! realVectorQ[hv] || Length[hv] != 5 || ! realMatrixQ[lm, {6, 6}],
      Return[logRead[<|"finite_real" -> False, "numerically_feasible" -> False,
        "error" -> "invalid_h_or_Lambda", "h" -> jsonSafe[hv], "Lambda" -> jsonSafe[lm]|>]]];
    tm = Table[Which[i == j, 1., j < i, hv[[j]], True, 0.], {i, 6}, {j, 6}];
    fl = DiagonalMatrix[lm.ee] - lm;
    omega = Join[-2 hv, {2 Total[hv]}];
    dm = DiagonalMatrix[Join[hv (2 - hv), {-Total[hv] (Total[hv] + 2)}]];
    prod = fl.tm;
    single = dm + (prod + Transpose[prod])/2;
    mat = Table[If[i <= j, single[[i, j]], single[[j, i]]], {i, 6}, {j, 6}];
    oldform = dm + (prod + Transpose[tm].Transpose[fl])/2;
    finite = realMatrixQ[mat, {6, 6}] && realMatrixQ[oldform, {6, 6}] &&
             realMatrixQ[single, {6, 6}] && realMatrixQ[fl, {6, 6}];
    If[! finite,
      snapshot = <|"finite_real" -> False, "h" -> hv, "Lambda" -> lm,
        "M" -> mat, "M_original_two_product" -> oldform, "M_single_product" -> single,
        "numerically_feasible" -> False, "error" -> "invalid_original_matrix"|>;
      If[TrueQ[initialFactor], initialSnapshot = jsonSafe[snapshot];
        snapshotExport = emit["EQ46_INITIAL", initialSnapshot];
        initialSnapshotExported = TrueQ[snapshotExport["ok"]]];
      Return[logRead[snapshot]]];
    flow = Transpose[fl].ee - omega; null = mat.ee; originalNull = oldform.ee;
    discrepancy = oldform - mat;
    symmetry = mat - Transpose[mat]; oldSymmetry = oldform - Transpose[oldform];
    mirrorError = Max[Abs[Flatten[mat - single]]];
    assemblyError = Max[Abs[Flatten[discrepancy]]];
    me = Max[Abs[flow]]; ne = Max[Abs[null]]; oldne = Max[Abs[originalNull]];
    lv = Extract[lm, pairs];
    ev = Check[Eigenvalues[mat], $Failed];
    pe = Check[Eigenvalues[mat[[1 ;; 5, 1 ;; 5]]], $Failed];
    ce = Check[Eigenvalues[Transpose[qq].mat.qq], $Failed];
    oldev = Check[Eigenvalues[oldform], $Failed];
    If[realVectorQ[ev], ev = Sort[ev]];
    If[realVectorQ[pe], pe = Sort[pe]];
    If[realVectorQ[ce], ce = Sort[ce]];
    If[realVectorQ[oldev], oldev = Sort[oldev]];
    spectraOK = realVectorQ[ev] && Length[ev] == 6 &&
       realVectorQ[pe] && Length[pe] == 5 && realVectorQ[ce] && Length[ce] == 5 &&
       realVectorQ[oldev] && Length[oldev] == 6;
    box = Min[hv] >= 1/4 && Max[hv] <= 6 && Min[lv] >= 0 && Max[lv] <= 400;
    snapshot = <|"stage" -> "original_before_factorization", "h" -> hv,
      "A" -> 1 + Total[hv], "Lambda" -> lm, "M" -> mat,
      "M_original_two_product" -> oldform, "M_single_product" -> single,
      "LT_single_product" -> prod, "L_flow" -> fl, "D" -> dm,
      "T" -> tm, "omega" -> omega, "input_variables_before_factorization" -> values,
      "flow_residual" -> flow, "null_residual" -> null,
      "original_two_product_null_residual" -> originalNull,
      "original_two_product_minus_symmetric_formula" -> discrepancy,
      "symmetry_residual" -> symmetry, "original_two_product_symmetry_residual" -> oldSymmetry,
      "full_eigenvalues" -> ev, "principal_eigenvalues" -> pe,
      "complement_eigenvalues" -> ce, "original_two_product_eigenvalues" -> oldev,
      "offdiagonal_signs" -> Thread[lv >= 0],
      "min_original_coefficient" -> Min[lv], "max_original_coefficient" -> Max[lv],
      "min_step" -> Min[hv], "max_step" -> Max[hv],
      "max_flow_residual" -> me, "max_null_residual" -> ne,
      "max_original_two_product_null_residual" -> oldne,
      "max_original_assembly_discrepancy" -> assemblyError,
      "max_single_product_mirror_discrepancy" -> mirrorError,
      "max_symmetry_residual" -> Max[Abs[Flatten[symmetry]]],
      "max_original_two_product_symmetry_residual" -> Max[Abs[Flatten[oldSymmetry]]],
      "original_search_boxes" -> TrueQ[box], "finite_real" -> finite,
      "spectra_finite_real" -> spectraOK, "numerically_feasible" -> False,
      "factorization_status" -> "not_attempted", "factor_valid" -> False|>;
    If[TrueQ[initialFactor],
      initialSnapshot = jsonSafe[snapshot];
      snapshotExport = emit["EQ46_INITIAL", initialSnapshot];
      initialSnapshotExported = TrueQ[snapshotExport["ok"]]];
    If[! TrueQ[spectraOK],
      Return[logRead[Join[snapshot, <|"error" -> "nonfinite_or_nonreal_spectrum"|>]]]];
    If[TrueQ[initialFactor],
      preChecks = TrueQ[box && me <= 10^-9 && ne <= 10^-9 && oldne <= 10^-9 &&
        assemblyError <= 10^-9 && mirrorError == 0 &&
        Max[Abs[Flatten[symmetry]]] == 0 && Min[lv] >= eps0 (1 - 10^-6) &&
        Min[ev] >= -10^-9 && Min[pe] >= 1/5400 - 10^-9 &&
        Min[ce] >= 1/900 - 10^-9 && initialSnapshotExported];
      If[! preChecks,
        factorizationStatus = "not_attempted_initial_original_checks_failed";
        Return[logRead[Join[snapshot, <|"factorization_status" -> factorizationStatus,
          "error" -> "initial_original_prechecks_failed"|>]]]];
      upper = Check[CholeskyDecomposition[mat[[1 ;; 5, 1 ;; 5]],
                     TargetStructure -> "Dense"], $Failed];
      factorizationOutput = jsonSafe[upper];
      factorOK = realMatrixQ[upper, {5, 5}]; factorValid = factorOK;
      If[! TrueQ[factorOK],
        factorizationStatus = "factorization_return_invalid";
        Return[logRead[Join[snapshot, <|"factorization_status" -> factorizationStatus,
          "factorization_output" -> factorizationOutput,
          "error" -> "expected_finite_real_5_by_5_factor"|>]]]];
      factorizationStatus = "valid_finite_real_5_by_5_upper_factor";
      cf = Transpose[upper];
     vUsed = Join[Take[values, 25], Flatten[Table[cf[[i, j]], {i, 5}, {j, i}]]];
      rr = Thread[vv -> vUsed],
      cf = cm /. rr];
    If[! realMatrixQ[cf, {5, 5}],
      Return[logRead[Join[snapshot, <|"error" -> "invalid_numeric_factor_at_readback",
        "factor_output" -> jsonSafe[cf]|>]]]];
    basisFactor = jj.cf;
    fr = mat - basisFactor.Transpose[basisFactor];
    mr = (mm /. rr) - mat; eqr = eq /. rr;
    If[! realMatrixQ[basisFactor, {6, 5}] || ! realMatrixQ[fr, {6, 6}] ||
       ! realMatrixQ[mr, {6, 6}] || ! realVectorQ[eqr],
      Return[logRead[Join[snapshot, <|"error" -> "invalid_factor_or_model_residual",
        "C" -> cf, "full_factor" -> basisFactor, "full_factor_residual" -> fr,
        "model_minus_original_residual" -> mr, "factor_equalities" -> eqr|>]]]];
    fdiag = Diagonal[cf];
    box = box && Max[Abs[Flatten[cf]]] <= 100 && Max[Abs[Flatten[basisFactor]]] <= 100;
    diagok = Min[fdiag] >= 0;
    fe = Max[Abs[Flatten[fr]]]; mre = Max[Abs[Flatten[mr]]];
    feas = TrueQ[box && diagok && me <= tol && ne <= tol && oldne <= tol && fe <= tol &&
                  Min[ev] >= -psdtol && mre <= psdtol && assemblyError <= psdtol &&
                  mirrorError == 0 && Max[Abs[Flatten[symmetry]]] == 0];
    out = Join[snapshot, <|"stage" -> "complete_original_readback",
      "C" -> cf, "full_factor" -> basisFactor, "variables" -> vUsed,
      "full_factor_residual" -> fr, "model_minus_original_residual" -> mr,
      "factor_equalities" -> eqr, "factor_diagonal_signs" -> Thread[fdiag >= 0],
      "max_factor_residual" -> fe, "max_model_original_residual" -> mre,
      "max_factor_equality_residual" -> Max[Abs[eqr]],
      "all_search_boxes" -> TrueQ[box], "numerically_feasible" -> feas,
      "factor_valid" -> True, "factorization_status" -> If[TrueQ[initialFactor],
         factorizationStatus, "numeric_optimizer_factor_validated"],
      "exceeds_exact_threshold_numerically" -> TrueQ[1 + Total[hv] > gamma],
      "credible_target" -> TrueQ[feas && 1 + Total[hv] > gamma + 10^-6]|>];
    logRead[out]];

   a0 = N[Sqrt[2]]; b0 = (-a0 + Sqrt[10 + 8 a0])/2;
   t0 = N[99/100]; delta0 = N[1/100]; eps0 = N[1/10000000];
   x0 = t0 a0; y0 = t0 b0; s0 = x0 + y0; cap0 = 1 + s0;
   d0 = (a0 - 1) cap0 - delta0;
   cc0 = (cap0 + d0)/(cap0 - d0); kk0 = 1 + 2 cc0;
   tau0 = delta0 (2 a0 cap0 - delta0)/(cap0 - d0); eta0 = 2 tau0;
   u0 = 2 s0 (1 + x0)/y0; v0 = 2 s0 cap0/y0;
   h0 = {x0, y0, 1 + d0, x0, y0};
   n0 = Table[Which[MemberQ[{{4, 3}, {4, 6}}, off[[i]]], 2 cc0 x0 + eps0,
                   off[[i]] == {5, 3}, 2 cc0 y0 + eps0, True, eps0], {i, 20}];
   z0 = {1., 1 + x0, cap0, cap0 + 1 + d0, 2 cap0 + d0 - y0, 2 cap0 + d0};
   sumz0 = 2 + cap0 + 3 (2 cap0 + d0) - 2 y0;
   w0 = {(sumz0 - 6)/x0, (2 sumz0 - 6 (2 + x0))/y0,
     (3 sumz0 - 6 (2 + x0 + cap0))/(cap0 + d0),
     (6 (2 + x0 + cap0 + 2 cap0 + d0) - 4 sumz0)/y0,
     (sumz0 - 6 (cap0 + 1 + d0))/x0};
   gam0 = 1 - w0;
   direct = {{0., 2, 0, 0, 0, 0}, {2 (1 + x0), 0, u0, 0, 0, 0},
    {0, v0, 0, 0, 0, 2 cc0 d0 + eta0},
    {0, 0, 2 cc0 x0, 0, 2 kk0, 2 cc0 x0},
    {0, 0, 2 cc0 y0, 2 kk0 (1 + x0), 0, kk0 u0 + 2 cc0 y0},
    {0, 0, 2 cc0 + eta0, 0, kk0 v0, 0}};
   Do[direct[[off[[i, 1]], off[[i, 2]]]] += eps0, {i, 20}];
   Do[direct[[tree[[i, 1]], tree[[i, 2]]]] += eps0 gam0[[i]];
      direct[[tree[[i, 2]], tree[[i, 1]]]] += eps0 gam0[[i]], {i, 5}];
   initialRead = read[Join[h0, n0, ConstantArray[0., 15]], True];
   If[! TrueQ[initialRead["finite_real"]],
     status = "initial_nonfinite_abort"; stopReason = status; Throw[$Failed, tag]];
   If[! TrueQ[Lookup[initialRead, "factor_valid", False]],
     status = "initial_factor_or_original_checks_abort"; stopReason = status;
     Throw[$Failed, tag]];
   initial = initialRead["variables"];
   directError = Max[Abs[Flatten[initialRead["Lambda"] - direct]]];
   initialChecks = <|
     "all_numerical_feasibility_checks" -> TrueQ[initialRead["numerically_feasible"]],
     "dense_coefficient_margin" -> TrueQ[initialRead["min_original_coefficient"] >= eps0 (1 - 10^-6)],
     "full_psd_check" -> TrueQ[Min[initialRead["full_eigenvalues"]] >= -10^-9],
     "complement_margin" -> TrueQ[Min[initialRead["complement_eigenvalues"]] >= 1/900 - 10^-9],
     "leading_margin" -> TrueQ[Min[initialRead["principal_eigenvalues"]] >= 1/5400 - 10^-9],
     "flow_tight" -> TrueQ[initialRead["max_flow_residual"] <= 10^-9],
     "null_tight" -> TrueQ[initialRead["max_null_residual"] <= 10^-9],
     "factor_tight" -> TrueQ[initialRead["max_factor_residual"] <= 10^-9],
     "chart_direct_array_match" -> TrueQ[directError <= 10^-9],
     "original_assembly_agreement" -> TrueQ[initialRead["max_original_assembly_discrepancy"] <= 10^-9],
     "literal_symmetric_formula" -> TrueQ[initialRead["max_symmetry_residual"] == 0 &&
         initialRead["max_single_product_mirror_discrepancy"] == 0],
     "pre_factor_snapshot_exported" -> initialSnapshotExported,
     "factor_shape_and_finite_entries" -> factorValid|>;
   initialPassed = And @@ Values[initialChecks]; initialElapsed = AbsoluteTime[] - started;
   lastStep = initial; lastRead = initialRead;
   If[! TrueQ[initialPassed], status = "initial_original_readback_failed_abort";
     stopReason = status; Throw[$Failed, tag]];
   bestRead = initialRead; bestA = initialRead["A"]; maxTrialCapacity = bestA;
   row[ir_, er_, rr_] := {ir, er, AbsoluteTime[] - started, rr["A"],
     rr["min_original_coefficient"], rr["max_flow_residual"], rr["max_null_residual"],
     Min[rr["full_eigenvalues"]], rr["max_factor_residual"], rr["numerically_feasible"]};
   onEval[] := (
     evals++; lastEval = vv;
     If[! realVectorQ[lastEval] || Length[lastEval] != 40,
       status = "nonnumeric_evaluation_callback_abort"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     maxTrialCapacity = Max[maxTrialCapacity, 1 + Total[h]];
     If[evals >= 2000, status = "evaluation_callback_cap"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     If[AbsoluteTime[] - started >= 22, status = "callback_wall_guard"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]]);
   onStep[] := Module[{point = vv, rr},
     iter++;
     If[AbsoluteTime[] - started >= 22, status = "step_wall_guard"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     rr = read[point]; lastStep = point; lastRead = rr;
     If[! TrueQ[rr["finite_real"]] || ! TrueQ[Lookup[rr, "factor_valid", False]],
       status = "invalid_original_step_readback_abort"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     If[TrueQ[rr["numerically_feasible"]] && rr["A"] > bestA,
        bestRead = rr; bestA = rr["A"]];
     If[iter == 1 || Mod[iter, 10] == 0, AppendTo[history, row[iter, evals, rr]]];
     If[TrueQ[rr["credible_target"]], status = "credible_original_candidate"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     If[iter >= 598 || reads >= 599, status = "step_readback_cap"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
     If[AbsoluteTime[] - started >= 22, status = "step_wall_guard"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]]];
   starts = Transpose[{vv, initial}];
   If[AbsoluteTime[] - started >= 22, status = "build_initial_wall_guard"; Throw[$Aborted, tag]];
   status = "optimizing"; calls = 1; optimizationStarted = AbsoluteTime[];
   sol = Catch[TimeConstrained[
     FindMinimum[Evaluate[{-(1 + Total[h]), cons}], Evaluate[starts],
       Method -> "InteriorPoint", WorkingPrecision -> MachinePrecision,
       AccuracyGoal -> 8, PrecisionGoal -> 8, MaxIterations -> 600,
       EvaluationMonitor :> onEval[], StepMonitor :> onStep[]],
     Max[0.01, 23 - (AbsoluteTime[] - started)],
     status = "optimizer_time_guard"; $Aborted], tag];
   optimizationElapsed = AbsoluteTime[] - optimizationStarted;
   If[status == "optimizing", status = If[MatchQ[sol, {_?NumericQ, _List}],
       "optimizer_returned_no_convergence_asserted", "optimizer_no_numeric_return"]];
   stopReason = status;
   , Max[0.01, 23 - (AbsoluteTime[] - started)],
     status = "model_and_optimizer_time_guard"; stopReason = status; $Aborted], tag];

  If[stopReason == "not_started", stopReason = status];
  If[TrueQ[initialPassed] && calls == 1,
   If[MatchQ[sol, {_?NumericQ, _List}], ruleSol = Last[sol]; finalVector = vv /. ruleSol,
     finalVector = lastStep];
   If[realVectorQ[finalVector] && Length[finalVector] == 40 && reads < 600,
      finalRead = read[finalVector], finalRead = lastRead];
   If[TrueQ[finalRead["numerically_feasible"]] && finalRead["A"] > bestA,
      bestRead = finalRead; bestA = finalRead["A"]];
   If[TrueQ[bestRead["credible_target"]], status = "credible_original_candidate"],
   finalRead = initialRead];
  preExportElapsed = AbsoluteTime[] - started;
  result = <|
    "final_readback" -> finalRead,
    "best_feasible_readback" -> bestRead,
    "initial_readback" -> initialRead,
    "initial_pre_factor_snapshot" -> initialSnapshot,
    "initial_pre_factor_snapshot_exported" -> initialSnapshotExported,
    "factorization_status" -> factorizationStatus,
    "factorization_output" -> factorizationOutput,
    "factor_shape_and_finite_entries_validated" -> factorValid,
    "J_full_factor_basis" -> jj, "orthonormal_complement_basis" -> qq,
    "initial_direct_Lambda" -> direct, "initial_direct_chart_max_error" -> directError,
    "initial_checks" -> initialChecks, "initial_passed" -> initialPassed,
    "status" -> status, "optimizer_stop_reason" -> stopReason, "version" -> $Version,
    "method" -> "InteriorPoint", "accuracy_goal" -> 8, "precision_goal" -> 8,
    "original_readback_tolerance" -> tol, "numerical_psd_tolerance" -> psdtol,
    "tolerances_exact_inputform" -> <|"original" -> ToString[tol, InputForm],
       "psd" -> ToString[psdtol, InputForm]|>,
    "exact_threshold" -> ToString[gamma, InputForm], "accounted_seconds" -> 30,
    "optimizer_invocations" -> calls, "evaluation_callback_count" -> evals,
    "step_monitor_count" -> iter, "original_readback_count" -> reads,
    "max_optimizer_iterations" -> 600, "callback_cap" -> 2000, "readback_cap" -> 600,
    "variable_count" -> Length[vv], "factor_equality_count" -> Length[eq],
    "offtree_pairs_original_zero_based" -> (off - 1),
    "solver_result_inputform" -> ToString[sol, InputForm],
    "kernel_messages" -> ToString[$MessageList, InputForm],
    "sampled_history_scope" -> "StepMonitor first and every tenth; final row separate. No evaluation trace stored; total callback count exact.",
    "sampled_history_columns" -> {"step", "callback", "seconds", "capacity", "min_Lambda",
       "flow_inf", "null_inf", "full_min_eigenvalue", "factor_inf", "numerically_feasible"},
    "sampled_history" -> history, "sampled_step_rows" -> Length[history],
    "all_original_readback_summaries" -> readbackLog,
    "original_readback_summaries_count" -> Length[readbackLog],
    "unsampled_step_count" -> iter - Length[history],
    "final_history_row" -> If[TrueQ[initialPassed] && AssociationQ[finalRead] &&
                  TrueQ[Lookup[finalRead, "factor_valid", False]], row[iter, evals, finalRead], Null],
    "maximum_trial_capacity_not_feasibility_claim" -> maxTrialCapacity,
    "last_evaluation_vector_unchecked_if_distinct_from_final" -> lastEval,
    "exact_reconstruction_attempted" -> exactAttempted,
    "model_build_seconds" -> modelBuildElapsed,
    "initial_checks_complete_seconds_from_start" -> initialElapsed,
    "optimizer_seconds" -> optimizationElapsed,
    "kernel_seconds_before_export" -> preExportElapsed|>;
  exportStarted = AbsoluteTime[];
  exportResult = emit["EQ46_FINAL", result];
  kernelElapsed = AbsoluteTime[] - started;
  Print["EQ46_FOOTER_JSON=", ExportString[jsonSafe[<|"record_type" -> "EQ46_FOOTER",
      "status" -> status, "initial_passed" -> initialPassed,
      "best_feasible_A" -> If[bestRead === Null, Null, bestA],
      "optimizer_invocations" -> calls, "evaluation_callback_count" -> evals,
      "step_monitor_count" -> iter, "original_readback_count" -> reads,
      "final_export" -> exportResult, "initial_export" -> snapshotExport,
      "factorization_status" -> factorizationStatus,
      "encoding" -> "base64-gzip-UTF8-JSON-with-tagged-non-JSON-values",
      "kernel_seconds_including_payload_export" -> kernelElapsed,
      "payload_export_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - exportStarted,
      "accounted_seconds" -> 30|>], "RawJSON", "Compact" -> True]];
  "EQ46_COMPLETE",
  26.5,
  Print["EQ46_FOOTER_JSON=", ExportString[jsonSafe[<|"record_type" -> "EQ46_FOOTER",
      "status" -> "overall_kernel_timeout", "initial_passed" -> initialPassed,
      "optimizer_invocations" -> calls, "evaluation_callback_count" -> evals,
      "step_monitor_count" -> iter, "original_readback_count" -> reads,
      "initial_pre_factor_snapshot_exported" -> initialSnapshotExported,
      "factorization_status" -> factorizationStatus,
      "kernel_messages" -> ToString[$MessageList, InputForm],

"""One new reservation and lossless persistence. No mathematical evaluation."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import datetime
import fcntl
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import re
import signal
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LEDGER = BASE.parent / 'equality_chart_repair_20261001_budget.json'


def utc():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def write(path, data):
    temp = path.with_name(path.name + '.tmp')
    with temp.open('w') as stream:
        json.dump(data, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(temp, path)


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def parse_objects(text):
    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
    for match in re.finditer(r'\{', text):
        try:
            obj, _ = decoder.raw_decode(text[match.start():])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            yield obj


def strings(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        yield value
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        for v in value.values():
            yield from strings(v)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for v in value:
            yield from strings(v)


def decode_stream(alltext, label, destination):
    """Always retain encoded/decoded bytes, including invalid JSON payloads."""
    info = {'label': label, 'complete': False, 'json_object': False}
    hits = re.findall(re.escape(label) + r'_CHUNK_(\d+)_OF_(\d+)=\s*([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)', alltext)
    chunkmap = {}
    totals = set()
    try:
        for index, total, chunk in hits:
            k = int(index)
            if k in chunkmap and chunkmap[k] != chunk:
                raise ValueError('Conflicting duplicate chunk')
            chunkmap[k] = chunk
            totals.add(int(total))
        info['received_chunk_indices'] = sorted(chunkmap)
        info['announced_chunk_totals'] = sorted(totals)
        write(destination.with_suffix('.chunks.json'), {'chunks': chunkmap, 'totals': sorted(totals)})
        if len(totals) == 1 and set(chunkmap) == set(range(1, next(iter(totals)) + 1)):
            encoded = ''.join(chunkmap[i] for i in sorted(chunkmap))
            destination.with_suffix('.base64.txt').write_text(encoded)
            compressed = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
            destination.with_suffix('.received.gz').write_bytes(compressed)
            plain = gzip.decompress(compressed)
            destination.with_suffix('.received.txt').write_bytes(plain)
            info['complete'] = True
            info['payload_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(plain).hexdigest()
            obj = json.loads(plain)
        else:
            marker = label + '_JSON_FALLBACK='
            if marker not in alltext:
                return None, info
            tail = alltext.split(marker, 1)[1]
            obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(tail.lstrip())
            destination.with_suffix('.received.txt').write_text(tail.lstrip()[:end])
            info['complete'] = True
            info['fallback_plain_JSON'] = True
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            info['error'] = {'tag': 'non_object_JSON', 'received_type': type(obj).__name__}
            return None, info
        info['json_object'] = True
        write(destination.with_suffix('.json'), obj)
        return obj, info
    except Exception as error:
        info['error'] = {'tag': 'decode_error', 'detail': repr(error)}
        return None, info


def real(x):
    return isinstance(x, (int, float)) and not isinstance(x, bool) and math.isfinite(x)


def vector(x, n):
    return isinstance(x, list) and len(x) == n and all(real(a) for a in x)


def matrix(x, m, n):
    return isinstance(x, list) and len(x) == m and all(vector(row, n) for row in x)


def original_arrays_available(r):
    return isinstance(r, dict) and vector(r.get('h'), 5) and matrix(r.get('Lambda'), 6, 6) \
        and matrix(r.get('M'), 6, 6) and matrix(r.get('M_original_two_product'), 6, 6) \
        and vector(r.get('flow_residual'), 6) and vector(r.get('null_residual'), 6)


def compact_readback(r):
    if not isinstance(r, dict):
        return r
    keys = ['h', 'A', 'min_original_coefficient', 'max_original_coefficient',
            'max_flow_residual', 'max_null_residual', 'max_factor_residual',
            'max_model_original_residual', 'max_factor_equality_residual',
            'full_eigenvalues', 'complement_eigenvalues', 'principal_eigenvalues',
            'original_two_product_eigenvalues', 'max_original_assembly_discrepancy',
            'max_single_product_mirror_discrepancy', 'max_symmetry_residual',
            'max_original_two_product_symmetry_residual',
            'max_original_two_product_null_residual', 'factorization_status',
            'factor_valid', 'numerically_feasible', 'credible_target', 'all_search_boxes', 'error']
    return {k: r[k] for k in keys if k in r}


def reserve():
    ledger = json.loads(LEDGER.read_text())
    manifest = json.loads((BASE / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    assert ledger['status'] == 'allocated_not_started'
    assert ledger['charged_jobs_used'] == 0 and ledger['accounted_seconds_used'] == 0
    assert ledger['in_flight'] is None and ledger['charged_job_limit'] == 1
    assert ledger['accounted_seconds_limit'] == 30
    assert not (BASE / 'reservation.json').exists()
    for name, expected in manifest['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(BASE / name) == expected, 'Source changed after registration: ' + name
    receipt = {
        'job_name': 'equality_chart_symmetric_assembly_single_repair',
        'status': 'reserved_charged', 'reserved_utc': utc(),
        'accounted_seconds': 30, 'measured_seconds': None,
        'source_sha256': manifest['source_sha256'],
        'manifest_sha256': digest(BASE / 'manifest.json'),
        'optimizer_invocation_limit': 1, 'kernel_time_constraint': 27,
        'local_postprocessing_guard_seconds': 3, 'no_retry': True,
        'old_failed_job_remains_charged': 30,
    }
    ledger.update(status='active_single_repair_reserved', charged_jobs_used=1,
                  accounted_seconds_used=30, in_flight=receipt['job_name'])
    ledger['jobs'].append(receipt)
    ledger['reservation_plus_accounted_seconds'] = 930
    write(LEDGER, ledger)
    write(BASE / 'reservation.json', receipt)
    print(json.dumps(receipt))


def finish():
    began = time.perf_counter()
    save_seconds = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0.0
    outcome = {'status': 'closed_unknown_output', 'raw_file': 'raw_received.json',
               'accounted_seconds': 30, 'local_raw_save_seconds': save_seconds,
               'complete_initial_original_arrays_available': False,
               'complete_final_original_arrays_available': False,
               'no_retry': True, 'formal_calls': 0, 'new_accepted_facts': 0}
    result = initial = footer = None

    def alarm(*_):
        raise TimeoutError('Local persistence/decode guard expired')

    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm)
    try:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, max(0.001, 2.5 - save_seconds))
        raw = json.loads((BASE / 'raw_received.json').read_text())
        outcome['transport_wall_seconds'] = raw.get('transport_wall_seconds')
        texts = list(strings(raw.get('tool_result', raw)))
        alltext = '\n'.join(texts)
        (BASE / 'raw_text_received.txt').write_text(alltext)
        for obj in parse_objects(alltext):
            if obj.get('record_type') == 'EQ46_FOOTER':
                footer = obj
        if footer is not None:
            write(BASE / 'footer.json', footer)
            outcome['footer'] = footer
            outcome['measured_kernel_seconds'] = footer.get(
                'kernel_seconds_including_payload_export', footer.get('kernel_seconds'))
            for key in ('initial_passed', 'optimizer_invocations', 'evaluation_callback_count',
                        'step_monitor_count', 'original_readback_count', 'factorization_status'):
                if key in footer:
                    outcome[key] = footer[key]
        initial, initial_info = decode_stream(alltext, 'EQ46_INITIAL', BASE / 'initial_snapshot')
        result, final_info = decode_stream(alltext, 'EQ46_FINAL', BASE / 'result')
        outcome['initial_stream'] = initial_info
        outcome['final_stream'] = final_info
        outcome['all_export_chunks_received'] = initial_info['complete'] and final_info['complete']
        outcome['complete_initial_original_arrays_available'] = original_arrays_available(initial)
        outcome['initial_pre_factor_summary'] = compact_readback(initial)
        if result is not None:
            for key in ('status', 'optimizer_stop_reason', 'initial_passed', 'initial_checks',
                        'initial_direct_chart_max_error', 'optimizer_invocations',
                        'evaluation_callback_count', 'step_monitor_count', 'original_readback_count',
                        'original_readback_summaries_count', 'factorization_status',
                        'factor_shape_and_finite_entries_validated', 'initial_pre_factor_snapshot_exported',
                        'kernel_messages', 'model_build_seconds',
                        'initial_checks_complete_seconds_from_start', 'optimizer_seconds',
                        'kernel_seconds_before_export', 'sampled_step_rows', 'unsampled_step_count',
                        'maximum_trial_capacity_not_feasibility_claim', 'exact_reconstruction_attempted'):
                if key in result:
                    outcome['optimizer_status' if key == 'status' else key] = result[key]
            final = result.get('final_readback')
            outcome['complete_final_original_arrays_available'] = original_arrays_available(final)
            outcome['initial_summary'] = compact_readback(result.get('initial_readback'))
            outcome['final_summary'] = compact_readback(final)
            outcome['best_feasible_summary'] = compact_readback(result.get('best_feasible_readback'))
            best = result.get('best_feasible_readback')
            candidate = isinstance(best, dict) and best.get('credible_target') is True
            if candidate:
                outcome['status'] = 'closed_credible_numerical_candidate'
            elif result.get('initial_passed') is not True:
                outcome['status'] = 'closed_initial_original_or_factor_failure'
            else:
                outcome['status'] = 'closed_no_credible_seed'
        elif initial is not None:
            outcome['status'] = 'closed_incomplete_final_initial_snapshot_preserved'
        else:
            outcome['status'] = 'closed_transport_or_encoding_failure'
        outcome['raw_sha256'] = digest(BASE / 'raw_received.json')
        outcome['raw_warning_prefix'] = alltext.split('EQ46_INITIAL_CHUNK_', 1)[0]
    except Exception as error:
        outcome['status'] = 'closed_output_processing_error'
        outcome['processing_error'] = {'tag': 'exception', 'detail': repr(error)}
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
        outcome['local_decode_persist_seconds_before_closure'] = time.perf_counter() - began
        outcome['local_raw_save_plus_decode_seconds_before_closure'] = save_seconds + time.perf_counter() - began
        write(BASE / 'outcome.json', outcome)
        ledger = json.loads(LEDGER.read_text())
        ledger['status'] = outcome['status']
        ledger['in_flight'] = None
        ledger['closed_utc'] = utc()
        ledger['jobs'][0].update(status=outcome['status'], finished_utc=ledger['closed_utc'],
                                 outcome_file=str(BASE / 'outcome.json'), outcome=outcome)
        ledger['measured_kernel_seconds_used'] = outcome.get('measured_kernel_seconds')
        ledger['measured_seconds_used'] = outcome.get('measured_kernel_seconds')
        ledger['optimizer_callbacks_used'] = outcome.get('evaluation_callback_count')
        ledger['original_readbacks_used'] = outcome.get('original_readback_count')
        ledger['optimizer_invocations_used'] = outcome.get('optimizer_invocations')
        ledger['iterations_observed'] = outcome.get('step_monitor_count')
        ledger['external_timeout_seconds_charged'] = 30 if outcome.get('measured_kernel_seconds') is None else 0
        ledger['unused_jobs'] = 0
        ledger['unused_accounted_seconds'] = 0
        ledger['no_renewal_inferred'] = True
        write(LEDGER, ledger)
        elapsed = save_seconds + time.perf_counter() - began
        write(BASE / 'local_postprocess_receipt.json', {
            'raw_save_plus_decode_and_ledger_close_seconds': elapsed,
            'local_3_second_cap_met': elapsed <= 3,
            'scope': 'excludes only writing this small receipt and stdout emission'})
    print(json.dumps(outcome, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    with (BASE / 'ledger.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        if sys.argv[1] == 'reserve':
            reserve()
        elif sys.argv[1] == 'finish':
            finish()
        else:
            raise ValueError('Unknown action')

# One full equality-chart search: derivation and frozen plan

Status: joint UNVERIFIED research derivation and numerical-discovery plan.
Owner max3, continuation round after completed44, ceiling45/attempted46.
Authority: current TASK.md and master guidance59c43473b63b1939. Exactly
ONE mathematical job,30 conservatively charged seconds; no retry, formal
gate, installation, consult, native agent, or automatic renewal.

The original exact-profile Goal, W=2R, and the sufficient threshold in
accepted4c92d3fc4eb6153e are unchanged. The numerical target is an actual
length5 word with A>Gamma5=7977607/806000, preferably A>=99/10. A numerical
endpoint is only a candidate. No seed or original-target theorem is asserted.

## 1. Correctness inputs and reproduced equality chart

The accepted inputs are04219554e41d9750, Section10, and1252b8823bb5a290,
proof paragraph1. They give the original finite interpolation orientation
Q_ij=f_i-f_j+<g_i,x_j-x_i>+||g_i-g_j||^2/2<=0 and the certificate identity

 V_h+sum_(i!=j)Lambda_ij Q_ij=<M,Gram(g_0,...,g_5)>,
 V_h=2sum_(i<5)h_i(f_i-f_5)+sum_(i<5)h_i(1-h_i)||g_i||^2
                                      -s(s+1)||g_5||^2,
 s=sum h_i, A=1+s,
 T_ii=1, T_it=h_t for t<i, T_it=0 for t>i,
 L=diag(Lambda e)-Lambda,
 omega=(-2h_0,...,-2h_4,2s)^T,
 D=diag(h_i(2-h_i) for i<5,-s(s+2)), M=D+(LT+T^T L^T)/2,

provided L^T e=omega. All six gradients are independent formal variables,
e is the six-vector of ones, and Lambda has zero diagonal. All30 original
ordered off-diagonal coefficients must be nonnegative, and M must be PSD
on the whole R^6. The coefficient identity is also checked by separating
position terms sym(L(T-I)) and squared-gradient terms sym(L)-diag(omega)/2.
Adding the diagonal part of V_h yields exactly D+sym(LT).

Put z=Te, Z=diag(z), d(X)=Xe-X^Te, and d_z(X)=Xz-ZX^Te=d(XZ).
Both divergences have total sum zero. Direct coordinate calculation gives
2De+T^T omega=-Z omega: if p_i=sum_(t<i)h_t, its i<5 coordinate is
2h_i(2-h_i)-2h_i+2h_i(p_i+h_i)=2h_i(1+p_i)=-z_i omega_i.
The last coordinate is -2s(s+2)+2s=-2s(s+1).
Thus, when d(Lambda)=omega,

 2Me=Lz-Zomega=-d_z(Lambda).

Consequently the two original equalities are equivalent to
d(Lambda)=omega and d_z(Lambda)=0. Moreover, under the first equality,
e^TMe=0 because e^TDe=-(s^2+sum h_i^2) and z^Tomega=s^2+sum h_i^2.
If M is PSD, the quadratic (e+tv)^TM(e+tv) has zero constant term;
nonnegativity for both signs of t forces e^TMv=0 for all v. Hence Me=0
is necessary for every original feasible certificate and costs no solutions.

Use the path v=(0,1,2,5,4,3), oriented successively. For edge u->w let
S be the initial path segment through u, Delta=z_u-z_w, and N have all20
independent off-tree ordered entries, zero diagonal and tree entries.
Define

 alpha=sum_(i in S)omega_i-sum_(i in S,j outside S)(N_ij-N_ji),
 beta=-sum_(i in S,j outside S)(N_ij z_j-N_ji z_i).
 Lambda_uw=(z_u alpha-beta)/Delta,
 Lambda_wu=(z_w alpha-beta)/Delta,
 Lambda_ij=N_ij off the tree.

This solves a-b=alpha and z_w a-z_u b=beta. Every tree cut of each
residual divergence is zero. Rooting the tree, a leaf residual is zero
by its singleton subtree cut; subtracting zero child subtree sums proves
each parent residual zero, and the root follows from total sum zero.
Conversely every original equality array must satisfy these two cut
equations, whose determinant is -Delta, so its dependent entries are
uniquely the displayed formulas. The inverse just reads the20 off-tree
entries. They and all five h_i remain independent variables.

The successive cuts are {0},{0,1},{0,1,2},{0,1,2,5},{0,1,2,5,4}; their
Delta values are -h_0,-h_1,-(h_2+h_3+h_4),h_4,h_3. They are nonzero in
the registered box. This is a coordinate basis, not a support assumption.
At a zero Delta the actual compatibility condition is beta=z_u alpha;
if compatible the whole pair is (t+alpha,t), otherwise no completion
exists at those off-tree coordinates. These singular cases lie outside
this search box and are not declared infeasible for the original problem.
In particular a box restriction is not a global theorem about the cone.

## 2. Full-space factor equivalence, including singular factors

Write B for the leading5-by-5 block of M and J=[I_5;-1_5^T]. From Me=0
one obtains all final row and column entries, giving M=JBJ^T. For arbitrary
independent g_0,...,g_5 its quadratic form is
(g_(0:4)-g_5 1)^TB(g_(0:4)-g_5 1). It follows in both directions that
M>=0 iff B>=0. This identity does not identify any two gradients.

A symmetric PSD B has a lower triangular factor C with nonnegative
diagonal, B=CC^T, including the singular case. Induct on the first pivot
of the current PSD residual. A positive pivot p allows a square completion
and leaves the PSD Schur residual. If p=0, positivity of each two-variable
quadratic forces its whole off-diagonal row zero; set that factor column
zero and continue on the remaining principal submatrix. A negative pivot,
or zero pivot with nonzero off-diagonal row, is incompatible with PSD.
Conversely any CC^T is PSD. This establishes exact equivalence without
fixing rank. The full factor is F=JC; its last row is minus the sum of
the first five rows. All15 lower factor entries vary in the search.

## 3. Reproducing the specified strict start, without adopting a draft fact

Let a=sqrt2, rho=a-1, lambda=1+a,

Here is a full quadratic check of its remainder. Write

The tail-to-tail terms cancel between its two tail sums; bridge-to-tail

return `$Aborted`. The final original two-product evaluation had a tiny complex
conjugate eigenvalue pair. Every complete initial/final original numerical array
and every received message was retained. The ledger is CLOSED with no retry.

upper triangle merely represents that exact symmetry. The full proof and all

## Result 1: the positive interval cone is excluded at these new weights

This is a new derivation; the old b_i=h_i result was not reused outside its hypotheses. It covers arbitrary finite positive sums of the explicit variable-step interval modes, including m-dependent coefficients and supports. Those modes have diagonal `H=C Bmat+Bmat^T C^T`. It does NOT cover every general C or every possible diagonal-H C.

Let `delta_i=u_i-h_i`, and use the mode quantities q_i, B_i^nu, E_i^nu defined in the proof. The FULL diagonal is

    R_ii=q_i-(h_i-1)^2 q_(i+1)
         -delta_i[2(h_i-1)+delta_i].

The exact generalized prefix identity is

    q_k+sum_(i<k)R_ii
      =(T_k+1)^2-2sum_nu B_k^nu E_k^nu+Xi_k,

where, writing s=T_k and V, W3, K2 for the physical prefix sums of h_i^2, h_i^3, and h_i^2 T_i^2,

    Xi_k=[(s+1)(s^2-V)/2-(s^3-W3)/3]/S-K2/(4S^2)
         <=s^3/(6S)+s^2/(2S).

At the middle bridge, `s=s_(m-1)`, `K=k_(m-1)`, `S=2s+1+K`, and `delta_k=s(1+K)/(2S)`. The positive-mode cut equations and FULL PSD necessity imply

    K^2[1+2(s+1+K)/(s+1-K)]+2K delta_k
      <=(s+1)^2+s^3/(6S)+s^2/(2S).

With r=sqrt(2)-1, the literal enclosing-m limit forces `1+r^3<=1+r/6`, impossible because `6r^2>1` (equivalently `289>288`). Thus this entire cone fails for all sufficiently large inherited m. at every inherited depth j. The proof uses the exact image-radius update, the real physical word, and c<3.

    Y_J in [max(0,k_J-d_J),k_J],

   budget-valid, signed, nonscalar redistribution of the FINAL right terminal
   rows through the optimum is included explicitly; it vanishes on the failed
   left direction and cannot repair it.

These are scoped failures of THESE arrays. They are not legal primal
adversaries, lower bounds for W, or general-dual infeasibility results. No
unproved positive lift or feasible recursive base is left masquerading as a
result.

## 1. Physical word, accepted inputs, and original cone

Fix one enclosing integer m>=1536 throughout, including every child, and put

    lambda=1+sqrt(2), epsilon=1/(4m), beta=1-epsilon,
    c=lambda(1+epsilon), a=beta/c,
    H_0=(), H_(j+1)=(H_j,1+a*c^j,H_j), 0<=j<m.

The actual word is h=H_m of length n=2^m-1. Its terminal gradient is an
interpolation variable, not an extra update. The zero-perturbation calibration
means epsilon=0, a=1/lambda, c=lambda, with the same recursive physical word;
it is explicitly distinguished from the assigned positive epsilon.

Accepted inputs read in this round are:

* fact1252b8823bb5a290: the full original interpolation convention,
  objective certificate, terminal reduction and full-coordinate scope;
* fact04219554e41d9750: the unconditional original benchmark and the full
  primitive/history and objective identities, Sections10--11;
* fact5fd396eba75651e7: ONLY its scalar benchmark comparison on these words,
  Section10. Its restricted witness-family optima are not W upper bounds.

The complete findings74648afc6ca81e6c,83357ebfcaa1356b,
ee71972baf834490,dd4045b39aa0c257 were read as awareness. Their needed
coefficient identities are derived again within this ONE joint draft.
No unverified finding is an accepted predecessor. Data242f8d453ac26183
motivate considering changed finite blocks, but no floating-point equality,
coefficient, zero pattern, sign, rank or feasibility premise is taken from them.

Use normalized smoothness1 and x_star=g_star=f_star=0. The ORIGINAL formal
vectors x_0,g_0,...,g_n are independent. Write

    x_i=x_0-sum_(t<i)h_t g_t,
    Q_ij=f_i-f_j+<g_i,x_j-x_i>+||g_i-g_j||^2/2.

For an arbitrary advertised L>0, W_n(h) is the supremum of
2(f(x_n)-f(x_star))/(L||x_0-x_star||^2) over every finite-dimensional
Euclidean space, every convex differentiable f with L-Lipschitz gradient,
every minimizer x_star and every x_0!=x_star, with the actual updates
x_(i+1)=x_i-(h_i/L)grad f(x_i). Normalizing gives the formal convention
above. This is the original W=2R normalization with the specified minimizer.

Every ordered finite, optimum and terminal row remains in the model. On actual
trajectories Q_ij<=0 by fact1252. Put

    K_ij=lambda_ij for finite i!=j, K_ii=0,
    nu_i=lambda_(i,star), xi_i=lambda_(star,i),
    S=sum h_i, D=1+2S, P_i=sum_(t<i)h_t, h_n=0.

All FINAL K,nu,xi must be nonnegative. Exact value flow is

    sum_j K_ij-sum_j K_ji+nu_i-xi_i=2*1_(i=n).             (1)

In particular sum nu=2+sum xi. After (1), the entire original polynomial is

    M(q)=q||x_0||^2-sum_i nu_i<x_0,g_i>
          +sum_i nu_i[sum_(t<i)h_t<g_i,g_t>+||g_i||^2/2]
          +sum_i xi_i||g_i||^2/2
          +sum_(i!=j finite)K_ij[<g_i,x_j-x_i>+||g_i-g_j||^2/2]. (2)

Its original matrix is [[q,-nu^T/2],[-nu/2,C]]. Every entry is

    C_ii=out_i-1_(i=n)-h_i sum_(j>i)K_ij,
    2C_ij=-(K_ij+K_ji)-h_j sum_(v>j)K_iv
                             +h_i[nu_j+sum_(v<=i)K_jv], i<j, (3)
    out_i=nu_i+sum_j K_ij.

To check (2)--(3), each optimum-incoming row contributes its displayed
initial-point mixed term and its gradient position term. Optimum-outgoing
rows have no position term. Half the total incident mass at i, by (1), is
out_i-1_(i=n), including both optimum directions. A forward position row out
of i subtracts h_i K_ij from its diagonal. Difference squares and the two
possible position-row source indices give exactly the off-diagonal in (3).
No original coordinate or interpolation pair is removed.

When q>0, square completion gives

    M(q)=q||x_0-sum_i nu_i g_i/(2q)||^2
                       +sum_(i,j)[C_ij-nu_i nu_j/(4q)]<g_i,g_j>. (4)

Full PSD of (2), not just a compression of (4), would imply W_n(h)<=q.

For orientation, the actual Huber function Hub(x)=x^2/2 on |x|<=1 and
|x|-1/2 otherwise, started at x_0=D, has g_i=1 and
f_i=D-P_i-1/2 at every finite query. All finite Q_ij and Q_(i,star) are
zero; Q_(star,i)=-(2S-P_i). Consequently a necessary paid-row budget at
q=(1+eta)/D is

    sum_i xi_i(2S-P_i)<=D eta.                            (5)

At eta=0 this forces every xi_i=0. A tight PSD quadratic must then annihilate
(D,1,...,1). Direct differentiation of (2), using (1), gives the finite
coordinate contact equations

    (2S-P_i)nu_i=2h_i+sum_j K_ij(P_i-P_j).                (6)

For a derivation, twice the i-th gradient row sum of C is
2h_i+(1+P_i)nu_i+sum_j K_ij(P_i-P_j): the summed GD displacements use
the full flow, and the gradient-difference rows contribute nu_i. The equation
2Ce=D nu is therefore exactly (6). Equations (1),(6) are algebraic contact
conditions, not a positivity assertion.

## 2. Exact common-gradient compression with arbitrary finite redistribution

Consider ANY last join (H_j,d,H_j), with k=2^j-1 and physical bridge
d=1+a*c^j. In THIS section and Sections3,5,6,

    A=sum H_j, t=A+d, S=2A+d, D=1+2S, D_c=1+2A,
    p_l=sum of child steps before l, 0<=l<=k.

A is a STEP SUM; d is the PHYSICAL bridge, not its excess. Left labels
L_l=l include the bridge query L_k. Right labels R_i=k+1+i include the
original terminal R_k=n. On the exact original-coordinate subspace

    g_(L_l)=u for EVERY left label,
    g_(R_i)=v for EVERY right label, x_0=x,

positions are x_(L_l)=x-p_l u and x_(R_i)=x-t u-p_i v. This is a
quadratic-form test subspace, not a constraint on the original model.

Define nonnegative cross arrays and their moments

    B_il=K_(R_i,L_l), F_li=K_(L_l,R_i),
    B=sum_(i,l) B_il, F=sum_(l,i) F_li,
    pi_B=sum_(i,l)p_l B_il,
    pi_F=sum_(l,i)p_i F_li,
    nu_L=sum_l nu_(L_l), nu_R=sum_i nu_(R_i),
    xi_L=sum_l xi_(L_l), xi_R=sum_i xi_(R_i).

Here B is a cross-row total, distinct from the benchmark B_n. Then the FULL
polynomial restricts EXACTLY to

    M(q)=q||x||^2-nu_L<x,u>-nu_R<x,v>
                      +Gamma_L||u||^2+Gamma_R||v||^2+J<u,v>, (7)
    Gamma_L=B+pi_B-tF+sum_l(1+p_l)xi_(L_l),
    Gamma_R=D_c+F+pi_F+sum_i(1+p_i)xi_(R_i),
    J=t nu_R+(t-1)B-pi_B-F-pi_F.                         (8)

Thus its three-coordinate matrix is

    [[q,-nu_L/2,-nu_R/2],
     [-nu_L/2,Gamma_L,J/2],
     [-nu_R/2,J/2,Gamma_R]].                             (9)

Derivation retaining every within-block row: internal left finite positions
sum to sum_l p_l[xi_(L_l)-nu_(L_l)+sum_i B_il-sum_i F_li]||u||^2
by left flow. Right positions sum to
[2A+sum_i p_i(xi_(R_i)-nu_(R_i)-sum_l B_il+sum_l F_li)]||v||^2
by right flow.
An individual backward row has quadratic coefficients

    ||u||^2/2+(p_i+1/2)||v||^2+(t-p_l-1)<u,v>,

and an individual forward row has

    (p_l-t+1/2)||u||^2+||v||^2/2-(p_i+1)<u,v>.

The optimum-incoming rows supply nu_l(p_l+1/2)||u||^2 on the left and
nu_i[(p_i+1/2)||v||^2+t<u,v>] on the right, together with their x mixed
terms. The outgoing optimum rows supply xi_i||g_i||^2/2. Insert these into
(2). The p_l nu_l,p_i nu_i and the other internal-source moments cancel.
Aggregate flow nu_L-xi_L=B-F and nu_R-xi_R+B-F=2 reduces the remaining
diagonals to (8). This proves (7)--(9) for arbitrary final finite arrays,
including signed changes to their predecessors.

For xi=0, q=1/D, full PSD would force (D,1,1) into the kernel of (9).
It follows that

    pi_B-tF-pi_F=2S nu_L-2t.                             (10)

The Schur remainder in (9) is then necessarily
kappa_2*[[1,-1],[-1,1]], where

    kappa_2=Gamma_L-D nu_L^2/4=Gamma_R-D nu_R^2/4>=0.    (11)

Indeed the two row sums of that Schur remainder vanish. Since B-F=nu_L,
Gamma_L-Gamma_R=nu_L+pi_B-tF-pi_F-D_c. Equating this to
D(nu_L-1) gives (10). This is only a necessary two-block statement. The
explicit lift in the next section shows why it is not sufficient.

## 3. Screen I: moving the backward destination changes the moment

Use a child finite objective array K^c and nonnegative attachments mu_i
satisfying child value flow and algebraic contact at1/D_c, with sum mu=2.
No child PSD is presumed for the failure proof. Start at H_0 with K^c=0,
mu_0=2. A separate finite source array Lambda^j, defined in Section4,
has the canonical primitive flow but is not presumed PSD.

Put

    V=3A+2d, s=t/V, theta=1-s=(2A+d)/V.

Specify EVERY parent row by

    K_(L_l,L_v)=Lambda^j_lv/D,
    K_(R_i,R_v)=K^c_iv,
    K_(R_i,L_k)=s mu_i, with all other cross rows zero,
    nu_(L_l)=2h_l/D for l<k,
    nu_(L_k)=2s-2A/D,
    nu_(R_i)=theta mu_i,
    xi_i=0.                                             (12)

Here h_l is the actual left child step at l<k. At j=0 the two distinct
parent queries remain L_0,R_0; the child finite array and child step sum are
empty, and (12) gives nu_L=nu_R=K_(R_0,L_0)=1.

All final signs hold. The source Lambda^j is nonnegative by Section4.
For A>0, tD>A(3A+2d), since their difference is
A^2+4Ad+2d^2+A+d>0. Thus nu_(L_k)>0. The other signs follow from
0<s<1/2, theta>0; at A=0, s=theta=1/2.

Left source divergence is -2h_l/D at l<k and2A/D at k.
Incoming backward mass at k is2s. Inserting (12) gives zero left flow.
Right flow is (2*1_(i=k)-mu_i)+theta mu_i+s mu_i=2*1_(i=k).
This proves (1) on every original label, including the terminal.

This law does not keep the old initial-left-sample anchor or its old right
attachment scale. Its backward moment is pi_B=2s A, not the frozen moment
in the prior additive-cycle screens. Its compressed entries are

    nu_L=2s, nu_R=2theta, F=0,
    Gamma_L=2s(A+1), Gamma_R=D_c,
    kappa= D_c-D theta^2.                                (13)

They satisfy (10). The entire coarse matrix has the explicit squares

    ||x-D(su+theta v)||^2/D + kappa||u-v||^2.             (14)

The positive coarse curvature is a real change, not a renamed Schur cone.
For the actual final joins, kappa>0: multiplication by V^2 gives

    V^2 kappa=2A^3-4Ad^2-2d^3+5A^2+8Ad+3d^2.           (15)

When 0<d/A<1/2, the cubic part is
2A^3[1-2(d/A)^2-(d/A)^3]>0, and the quadratic part is positive.
The actual final words satisfy this ratio at m>=1536, as proved in Section7.

### The ACTUAL full lift, not only (14)

Let P_j be the complete source gradient polynomial of Section4. Let C^c
be the full child gradient block from (3), and define the algebraic child
remainder

    R^c(g_R)=sum_(i,v)[C^c_iv-D_c mu_i mu_v/4]<g_(R_i),g_(R_v)>,
    r_mu=sum_i mu_i g_(R_i), p=L_k, x_p=x_0-sum_(l<k)h_l g_(L_l).

R^c is a quadratic DEFINITION; its PSD is not assumed. Direct substitution
of ALL rows (12) into (2) gives the FULL original identity

    M_I(1/D)=P_j(g_L)/D+R^c(g_R)
       +||x_p+(A-Ds)g_p-(D theta/2)r_mu||^2/D
       +(kappa/4)||r_mu-2g_p||^2.                        (16)

For a detailed coefficient check, the left source identity and its canonical
optimum completion produce P_j/D and the square
||x_p-(A+1)g_p||^2/D. Replace the child's right optimum rows by
theta Q_(R_i,star)+s Q_(R_i,p). Their difference from Q_(R_i,star)
is s[-f_p+<g_(R_i),x_p-g_p>+||g_p||^2/2]. The child right starting
position is x_p-d g_p. After value cancellation and after its initial-point
square is subtracted, the remaining three-variable quadratic is

    ||x_p||^2/D+2(A/D-s)<x_p,g_p>+(A^2/D+2s)||g_p||^2
       -theta<x_p,r_mu>+(d-s)<g_p,r_mu>+D_c||r_mu||^2/4. (17)

Completing the x_p square yields (16): the remaining g_p diagonal equals
kappa, since sV=t, and its g_p,r_mu coefficient is -kappa. The r_mu
diagonal is kappa/4. This verifies every term, including the original
initial-point mixed terms, both terminals and every within-block direction.

Equation (16) also proves recursive algebraic contact: P_j annihilates
common gradients by Section4, a contacting child has R^c e=0, and both
displayed squared linear forms vanish at the full Huber vector. Thus the
parent annihilates that vector without any PSD assumption. Starting from
the empty child, (12) defines an actual flow/contact array at every depth.

### Feasible original-Silver calibration

At epsilon=0, Section4 gives P_j=0 identically. Also
d=1+(A+1)/lambda. Put u=1/lambda, so u^2+2u=1 and1/4<u<1/2.
Substituting d=uA+1+u into (15) gives

    V^2 kappa=2(1-u)A^3+(6-8u)A^2
                     +(1+u)(8u-2)A+(1+u)^2(1-2u)>0.   (18)

Every displayed coefficient is positive, including at A=0. Starting from
the empty full certificate ||x_0-g_0||^2, (16) inductively gives full PSD
at every original-Silver depth: Schur completion of a PSD child at positive
1/D_c makes R^c PSD; all other terms are positive squares. This is a joint
calibration proof, not a claimed fact for the perturbed words.

For every actual enclosing m, the one-step base is also fully PSD:

    M_1(1/(1+2b))=||x_0-(1+2b)(g_0+g_1)/2||^2/(1+2b)
                                      +(3-2b)||g_0-g_1||^2/4,
    b=1+a<sqrt(2)<3/2.                                 (19)

Nevertheless (16) has an unpaid full left source polynomial. Section4 gives
an explicit actual original direction where every term except P_j/D
vanishes and P_j<0. Thus (12) fails despite (14), without relying on any
unproved recursive child feasibility.

## 4. Complete source array and a zero-boundary H4 direction

In this section use capacity notation

    A_j=1+sum H_j, d_j=a*c^j,
    A_(j+1)=2A_j+d_j, physical level-j bridge=1+d_j.

Here d_j is the bridge EXCESS, different from d in Section3. For terminal z
define the original history polynomial

    V_j=2sum_(i<z)h_i(f_i-f_z)
              +sum_(i<z)h_i(1-h_i)||g_i||^2-A_j(A_j-1)||g_z||^2.

From Lambda^0=0, at each join with bridge p and terminal z, embed the
entire left array with weight1 and right array with weight k_j, and add

    u_j sum_(i right, i<z)h_i Q_(i,p)
      +v_j sum_(i right, i<z)h_i Q_(i,z)
      +w_j Q_(z,p)+z_j Q_(p,z),                         (20)
    u_j=2lambda,
    v_j=[u_j d_j+2(A_j+d_j)]/A_j,
    k_j=1+(u_j+v_j)/2,
    z_j=2A_j,
    w_j=4A_j+2d_j-u_j(A_j-1)
                         =2lambda+2(d_j-A_j/lambda).

All repetitions in (20) are aggregated onto their actual directed row. This
defines Lambda^j, not an executed recurrence. Define P_j by

    V_j+sum Lambda^j_iv Q_iv=P_j(g).                    (21)

The values cancel: writing A=A_j,d=d_j,s_c=A-1, the two required
identities are u_j+v_j=2(k_j-1) and u_j s_c+w_j-z_j=2(A+d).
These imply source flow out-in=-2h_i at nonterminals and2(A-1) at
the terminal. No optimum row is in this finite source array.

For a full quadratic audit, write r=sum of actual right steps times their
nonterminal gradients, T=2A+d, K=A(A-1), K_plus=T(T-1). The four
gradient polynomials in the order of (20), BEFORE multiplication, are

    d<r,g_p>+||r||^2/2+sum h_i(1-h_i)||g_i||^2/2+s_c||g_p||^2/2;
    -||r||^2/2+sum h_i(1-h_i)||g_i||^2/2+s_c||g_z||^2/2-<r,g_z>;
    d<g_z,g_p>+<g_z,r>+(||g_p||^2+||g_z||^2)/2;
    -(d+1/2)||g_p||^2+||g_z||^2/2-<g_p,r>-<g_p,g_z>.

Adding the history differences gives, with t_j=d_j/A_j, t_star=1/lambda,
Y=r-(A_j-1)g_z and Z=g_p-g_z, the exact full identity

    P_(j+1)=P_j^left+k_j P_j^right+E_j,
    E_j=(t_star-t_j)[(lambda+1)||Y||^2-2lambda A_j<Y,Z>
                                    +A_j^2(2+t_star+t_j)||Z||^2]. (22)

For example the ||r||^2 coefficient is (u_j-v_j)/2, the r,g_p
coefficient is u_j d_j-z_j, and the r,g_z coefficient is w_j-v_j.
They respectively equal (lambda+1)(t_star-t_j),
-2lambda A_j(t_star-t_j), and the coefficient obtained by expanding Y,Z
in (22). The bridge diagonal before substitution is
K-d-d^2+(u_j s_c+w_j)/2-(d+1/2)z_j, and the terminal diagonal is
-K_plus+k_j K+v_j s_c/2+(w_j+z_j)/2. Substitution supplies precisely
the two diagonals of (22). This checks all coefficients.

The bracket in (22) is positive definite in Y,Z. Its determinant divided by
A_j^2 is (lambda+1)(2+t_star+t_j)-lambda^2>=lambda>0; its first
diagonal is positive. Every common-gradient vector is annihilated by P_j,
by (22) and the empty base, because Y=Z=0 for those vectors.

To establish the actual ratios and every sign without using a previous
unverified obstruction, put v_h=a/(c-2). Since c(c-2)>1>beta,
0<v_h<1, and symbolic substitution into the physical sum equation gives

    A_j=v_h c^j+(1-v_h)2^j,
    t_j=(c-2)/[1+(1/v_h-1)(2/c)^j].                     (23)

Thus t_j increases strictly. Its first three levels obey

    A_0=1,d_0=a; A_1=2+a,d_1=beta;
    A_2=4+a(2+c),d_2=beta c,
    t_0<t_star, t_1<t_star, t_2>t_star.                  (24)

For the middle sign,
lambda d_1-A_1=epsilon[-lambda+2/(lambda(1+epsilon))]<0.
For the last, elementary expansion gives

    c(lambda d_2-A_2)=epsilon[(lambda+4)-(4lambda+2)epsilon
                                            -(5lambda+2)epsilon^2]>0. (25)

For 2<lambda<3 and epsilon<=1/12 its bracket exceeds
6-14/12-17/144>0. Consequently t_j>t_star for every j>=2.
The weights u_j,v_j,z_j,k_j are positive. At j=0, w_j=4+2a>0;
at j=1, A_1<lambda makes w_j>2lambda-2>0;
at j>=2, w_j>2lambda. Every final source multiplier is nonnegative.
At epsilon=0, all t_j=t_star and (22) gives P_j=0 identically,
in agreement with fact042's original primitive identity.

Now take an ORIGINAL H3 gradient vector w with entries1 at0,1,2,3
and0 at4,5,6,7. Both children in (22) have zero P_2 value: the left is
common-gradient, the right is zero. Its full value is

    P_3(w)=A_2^2-2A_2d_2-d_2^2=-E,
    E=(lambda d_2-A_2)(A_2+d_2/lambda)>0.                (26)

The physical displacement on this support is T_w=A_2+d_2. In H4 set

    v_i=1 at i=0,1,2,3;
    v_i=-1 at i=8,9,10,11;
    v_i=0 at EVERY other index0,...,15.                 (27)

These are actual query indices. The bridge7 and terminal15 are zero.
The two signed supports have the identical physical steps, so
sum_(i<15)h_i v_i=0. At its H4 join, Y=-T_w,Z=0, so (22) gives

    P_4(v)=-(1+k_3)E-(t_3-t_star)(lambda+1)T_w^2<0.      (28)

For any H_j with j>=4, place (27) in its FIRST actual H4 subword and set
every later gradient to zero. At each enclosing source join the root,
terminal and right block are zero. Equation (22) then gives exactly
P_j(v)=P_4(v), not a conjectured or numerical amplification.

Finally at the top join of H_m, set x_0=0, give its left H_(m-1) these
gradients, and set every right gradient, including the actual terminal, to
zero. For every m>=5 the original left terminal is zero, its displacement
is zero, and x_p=0. Hence EVERY term of (16) except its first vanishes:

    M_I(q)=P_4(v)/D<0 for EVERY real objective level q.  (29)

Changing q contributes only (q-1/D)||x_0||^2=0. This is the promised
full lift failure after a viable original-Silver baseline and a positive
actual coarse block. It identifies a within-child direction invisible to
its terminal, total displacement and the common-gradient compression.

## 5. Screen II: explicit signed replacement by a backward bridge fan

The next law removes the left finite source rather than trying to pay it.
Recursively use its own child objective array (K^c,mu) with sum mu=2,
starting from empty K=0,mu_0=2. At a join use the same A,d,V,s,theta as
Section3, and specify

    v_l=2h_l/(2S-p_l), l<k,
    K_(L_k,L_l)=v_l, with ALL other left finite rows zero;
    K_(R_i,R_v)=K^c_iv,
    K_(R_i,L_k)=s mu_i, all other cross rows zero;
    nu_(L_l)=v_l for l<k,
    nu_(L_k)=2s-sum_(l<k)v_l,
    nu_(R_i)=theta mu_i, xi=0.                          (30)

Relative to an inherited left child, its signed finite change is
-K^c plus the displayed fan. No original row is deleted from the model;
every FINAL multiplier has just been specified. This replacement explicitly
acts on the failing inherited H4 directions of Screen I.

Every denominator is at least V=2S-A>0. Therefore
sum v_l<=2A/V and nu_(L_k)>=2d/V>0. All other final signs hold.
At L_l< L_k, incoming fan weight v_l is canceled by its optimum attachment.
At the bridge, its outgoing fan plus its optimum attachment equals incoming
cross mass2s. The right flow is the child flow as in Screen I. Thus all
original value coefficients vanish.

This law is also algebraically Huber-contacting. At l<k equation (6) reads
(2S-p_l)v_l=2h_l. On the right, subtract the child version of (6):
theta(3A+d-p_i)mu_i=(2A-p_i)mu_i+s(d+p_i)mu_i, since theta V=2A+d.
The initial-point derivative vanishes because total attachment mass is2.
At the Huber vector M(D,e)=0. Homogeneity then forces the only remaining
bridge derivative to vanish. This proves (6) at the bridge also, without
asserting PSD. For j=0 the law agrees exactly with (19), so the actual
one-step base passes.

It fails an elementary original-coordinate test before any long-depth proof.
For l<k, (3) gives EXACTLY C_(L_l,L_l)=nu_(L_l)=v_l: there is no
finite outgoing row at that index. For q>0 choose only this gradient to be1
and choose x_0=v_l/(2q); every other original gradient is zero. Then

    M_II(q)=v_l-v_l^2/(4q).                             (31)

Thus a necessary condition for full PSD is q>=v_l/4. At q=zeta/D it is

    zeta>=D h_l/[2(2S-p_l)]>h_l/2.                     (32)

Nonpositive q cannot be PSD because the original mixed entry -v_l/2 is
nonzero. The same one-gradient test is part of the whole matrix, not a
postulated child or quotient.

Already at the original-Silver H3 calibration, the left child has a physical
step h_l=2 at p_l=sqrt(2). Its D=1+2S>2S-p_l, so (32) demands
zeta>1. It therefore fails this required sharp baseline after its valid
one-step base; no long recursive PSD argument is undertaken for it.

The same exact test also directly excludes the desired actual target levels.
At the final assigned join choose the root of its left H_(m-1), namely
l=2^(m-2)-1. Its actual step is h_l=1+a*c^(m-2), which grows without
bound with m. Equation (32) excludes every bounded whole-word zeta in this

Therefore

    q>=v_l/4=h_l/[2(2S_m-p_l)]>h_l/(4S_m)
                  >a/(4c^2)>3/250.                    (33)

The fixed-step original-coordinate test thus excludes any vanishing
certificate level through this fan. It is a restriction on THESE levels,
not on W. No feasibility at any higher level is asserted.

## 6. Screen III: retain the objective block, correct moments, reroute right rows

The third law retains its own entire left OBJECTIVE finite block, rather than
Screen I's primitive block or Screen II's deletion. Its base arrays have
xi=0 and start from K=0,mu_0=2 at H_0. At each join set

    K_(L_l,L_v)=K^c_lv + 2s mu_l*1_(v=k,l<k),
    K_(R_i,R_v)=K^c_iv,
    K_(R_i,L_k)=s mu_i, all other cross rows zero,

                   =2gamma t mu_l-2(1-gamma)h_l.        (35)

(34), with respectively u_l=0,v_l=2h_l/(2S-p_l), and

The left forward correction has a position cost that the compression does

Indeed the new optimum attachment decreases by2s mu_l while the finite

At the first nontrivial join H2, let b=1+a be the single child step and

    C_parent_00=1-2b(b+d)/(3b+2d)<0.                   (37)

which proves the actual strict sign in (37). Setting x_0=0,g_0=1 and

The same diagonal failure persists at all actual larger depths. Original

These are symbolic coefficient identities, never executed recurrences.

### A fully specified signed, nonscalar right-terminal redistribution

To exercise the additional freedom that the right finite block need not be
an exact copy, include this change ONLY at the final join, AFTER constructing
the xi=0 base arrays (34). Set eta=1/100 and q=(1+eta)/D. Let

    T_out=sum_(i<k)K^c_(k,i),
    delta_i=eta K^c_(k,i)/[2(1+T_out)], i<k.

Reduce K_(R_k,R_i) by delta_i, increase nu_(R_k) by sum delta_i,
and set xi_(R_i)=delta_i. All other final rows remain those of (34).
The change on each route is the signed polynomial

    delta_i[Q_(R_k,star)+Q_(star,R_i)-Q_(R_k,R_i)]
                  =delta_i<g_(R_k),g_(R_i)-x_(R_i)>.    (38)

Each final finite entry is nonnegative because
delta_i/K^c_(k,i)=eta/[2(1+T_out)]<1 when that entry is positive;
zero entries have delta_i=0. Each new optimum entry is nonnegative.
Flow cancels exactly: at R_k its lost finite outgoing mass is replaced by
optimum-incoming mass; at R_i its lost finite incoming mass is replaced by
optimum-outgoing mass. Optimum flow also balances. This rerouting is not an
additive balanced optimum cycle on a frozen finite base.

The right-terminal outgoing rows change while its other right finite rows
stay fixed. For right children of depth>=2, there are positive changed
terminal rows and positive unchanged nonterminal rows, so the finite block
is NOT a scalar copy. All actual target depths have this property.

The new rows have the exact Huber expenditure

    price=sum_(i<k)delta_i(2S-P_(R_i))
          <=2S sum_i delta_i<S eta<D eta.               (39)

Thus this is a genuine budget-valid original optimum-row payment at a
sufficiently small advertised whole-word loss. It nevertheless leaves the
original x_0=0,g_0=1,all-other-gradients0 test unchanged: every right
gradient is zero, including R_k, so (38) vanishes term by term. Its final
full value remains C^m_00<0, independently of q. This supplies an actual
signed finite change and terminal reweighting without hiding their price,
and demonstrates precisely why changing only those right rows is insufficient
for this law's left defect. The mutation is final-only, so no xi!=0 child is
silently fed into the xi=0 recursion (34).

must do so jointly with the coarse moments and all final multiplier signs.

flow/contact, or by an assertion that an arbitrary Schur problem is feasible.

# Fixed one-step-child inflation: two full-array attempts and the remaining sign problem

Status: COMPLETE JOINT ANALYTICAL DRAFT, UNVERIFIED. No fact submission or
formal verification is authorized in max round57. The fixed-child closure
question and the original unrestricted exact-profile Goal remain OPEN.
This is outcome (c) of TASK.md, not an actual physical-word counterexample.

The mathematical predecessor used is accepted fact04219554e41d9750,
proof Sections10--11: the original full primitive identity and the
primitive binary join. Its identity is used in its original coordinates.
Shared4f623d6a2c835679, b53b38b27498e8a0 and 9ab42650d239f6b0 were read
as awareness of failed approaches; no unverified statement from them is
assumed. The elementary input certificates used below are checked here.
The skew-completion background in sharedff8b941536cb035e is also awareness
only: the required completion is proved in full below, and the new
fixed-child pullback and two nonbasic failure tests are explicit.

There are exactly TWO mechanisms in this pilot:

1. Distribute each input ordered edge over all four ordered pairs between
   its physical two-node blocks, and determine child weights from flow.
   The entire convex distribution family fails on a legal nonbasic input.
   A particularly simple member has all30 multipliers strictly positive
   and exact flow, but its remainder is -1/2 on an explicit formal vector.
2. Preserve the full input PSD remainder by a parity-corrected pullback,
   solve all original real coefficient equalities by an explicit skew
   completion, and retain EVERY homogeneous skew and admissible remainder
   variation. The canonical completion fails a multiplier sign on the
   same nonbasic input. The remaining inequalities are stated exactly;
   no restriction to that canonical completion is declared lossless.

No numerical evaluation, parameter sweep, solver, symbolic program,
benchmark DP, installation, consult, subagent, or formal call is used.

## 1. Original coordinates, counts, and the fixed child

Normalize smoothness to1. For any word w=(w_0,...,w_(n-1)), write
S_w=sum w_i, A_w=1+S_w, and retain all n+1 formal gradients g_i and values
f_i. Put x_i=x_0-sum_(t<i)w_t g_t and

 Q_ij=f_i-f_j+<g_i,x_j-x_i>+||g_i-g_j||^2/2,
 V_w=2sum_(i<n)w_i(f_i-f_n)+sum_(i<n)w_i(1-w_i)||g_i||^2
                                      -S_w(S_w+1)||g_n||^2.

Let e be the all-ones column, T_ii=1, T_it=w_t for t<i, T_it=0 for t>i,
omega=(-2w_0,...,-2w_(n-1),2S_w)^T, and

 D=diag(w_0(2-w_0),...,w_(n-1)(2-w_(n-1)),-S_w(S_w+2)).

A full certificate consists of Lambda_ii=0, Lambda_ij>=0 for every
ordered i!=j, L=diag(Lambda e)-Lambda, L^T e=omega, and

 M=D+(LT+T^T L^T)/2 positive semidefinite.                    (1)

Here sym(B)=(B+B^T)/2; Gram is the matrix of pairwise gradient inner
products, and the matrix pairing in (2) is trace(M^T Gram).

The accepted original-coordinate identity is

 V_w+sum_(i!=j)Lambda_ij Q_ij=<M,Gram(g_0,...,g_n)>.          (2)

It holds as a polynomial in every formal gradient and value, without
identifying coordinates. The signs Q_ij<=0 hold on an actual trajectory
of a single convex differentiable1-smooth function. Consequently (1)
is a sufficient primitive certificate on all such trajectories.

In this manuscript only, set a=sqrt(2), C=1+a, d=a-1=1/C. The fixed child
is q=(a). Its two-node certificate is

 Lambda^q=[[0,2],[2C,0]], M^q=0.                             (3)

Indeed its flow is (-2a,2a). The diagonal entries of D+sym(LT) are
a(2-a)+2(1-a)=2-a^2=0 and -a(a+2)+2C=0. Twice the off-diagonal is
-2+2C(a-1)=0. Thus every entry of the full matrix is checked.

The arbitrary input h has length r>=1, h_i>=1, capacity A=1+sum h_i,
and its given full certificate (Lambda^h,M^h). Define

 beta_i=1+C(h_i-1)=C h_i-a,
 H=(a,beta_0,a,beta_1,...,a,beta_(r-1),a).                   (4)

Block i has physical node2i (its start) and node2i+1 (its endpoint),
for i=0,...,r. All 2r+2 gradients remain independent formal coordinates.
There are r+1 child steps and r bridges, so the physical length is
Nphys=2r+1 and there are (2r+2)(2r+1) ordered multiplier slots. Since beta_i>=1,
every step is positive. Direct summation, using C-a=1, gives

 1+sum H=1+(r+1)a+C sum h_i-r a=C A.                       (5)

This is a fixed-child statement only. Neither arbitrary-child closure
nor an exponent-based restriction on arbitrary seed capacity follows.

## 2. A nonbasic legal input, with its complete certificate

Take h=(3/2,3/2), A=4, and

 Lambda^h=[[0,1,1/2],[7/2,0,17/2],[1,14,0]].                (6)

Its six ordered entries are positive and its flow is (-3,-3,6).
With T=[[1,0,0],[3/2,1,0],[3/2,3/2,1]] and D=diag(3/4,3/4,-15),
the three diagonal entries of LT are (-3/4,-3/4,15). The sums of its
opposite off-diagonal entries are

 (LT)_01+(LT)_10=(-1-3/4)+7/4=0,
 (LT)_02+(LT)_20=-1/2+1/2=0,
 (LT)_12+(LT)_21=-17/2+(3/2+7)=0.

Hence the full M^h is zero. A length2 primitive binary tree built from
empty leaves contains a length1 empty-leaf join, whose step is a by the
accepted join equation. Neither step in (6) equals a. Thus this is a
nonbasic input for the present test, with all its certificate data checked.

Its physical inflated word is

 H=(a,b,a,b,a), b=(3+a)/2, capacity4C.                       (7)

The unit-quadratic trajectory from x_0=1 has scalar gradient column

 v=(1,-d,1/2,-d/2,1/4,-d/4)^T.                            (8)

In particular its primitive energy is zero: (4C)^2 v_5^2=1.
Equation(8) will test candidate remainder matrices; changing a coordinate
of (8) does NOT automatically give another actual function trajectory.

## 3. Mechanism1: every cross-block ordered pair is retained

For arbitrary input h choose t_i in[0,1], i=0,...,r, and let the two
weights in block i be pi_i=(t_i,1-t_i). For every i!=j and a0,b0 in{0,1},
set the cross-block output coefficient to

 Lambda^mix_(2i+a0,2j+b0)=C Lambda^h_ij pi_(i,a0) pi_(j,b0). (9)

Inside block i use mu_i Lambda^q, where, with S=A-1,

 mu_i=1-C h_i t_i/a for i<r,
 mu_r=1+C S t_r/a.                                        (10)

Require mu_i>=0. These are exact formulas on the original physical
indices. They neither replace a block by an oracle nor assume its
gradients equal. If all original off-diagonal entries and all weights
are positive and mu_i>0, every physical ordered coefficient is positive.

The cross-block flow at node2i is C t_i omega^h_i and at node2i+1 is
C(1-t_i)omega^h_i. The child adds (-2a mu_i,2a mu_i). Thus (10) gives
the required start flow -2a. For i<r the endpoint flow is
-2C h_i+2a=-2beta_i; for i=r it is 2CS+2a=2(CA-1).
Therefore (9)--(10) have the exact original physical flow. Nonnegativity
and flow alone leave the full matrix

 Mmix=D_H+sym(Lmix T_H)                                    (11)

to be tested on the entire physical space.

### 3.1 The entire convex block-distribution family fails on (6)

For the input (6), admissibility gives

 0<=t_0,t_1<=2a/(3C), 0<=t_2<=1.                           (12)

 L^T v=-2 T_H^(-T) D_H v=:

The shortfall is at least (16/3)d>0. This is a collective block-total

### 3.2 A fully positive instance with an exact negative remainder

Set all t_i=1/4 in (9). Then

 mu_0=mu_1=(10-3a)/16>0,  mu_2=(14+3a)/8>0.                (18)
